subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Alex picked up the boxes quite easily even they were heavy.
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**even they were heavy**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the conjunction "**even though**".
 
• Even though is a **subordinate conjunction.**
 
• It makes the fact in the main clause of the sentence look more **surprising**.
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of **even though **reveals that Alex is strong as he easily picks up the heavy boxes.

**The correct sentence is: ***Alex picked up the boxes quite easily **even though __**they were heavy.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**
